########################################################################
# Library split (2026-11-15 native cleanup)
#
#   uwb_core        pure C++ DSP/SIC cores; links only the C++ standard
#                   library + VOLK (+ Threads).  No GNU Radio, no PMT, no UHD.
#   uwb_native      native RX runtime: SC16 stream sources, replay, UHD
#                   device source, fixed-tone decorator, bounded pipeline.
#                   Links uwb_core + Threads (+ UHD when available).
#   gnuradio-uwb    GNU Radio adapter (gr::block classes, PMT/PDU ports),
#                   SHARED, built only when UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO=ON; links
#                   uwb_native (and with it uwb_core) so every symbol that
#                   used to live in libgnuradio-uwb still does.
#
# Each source file is compiled into exactly ONE of these targets, so no
# exported implementation is duplicated across shared libraries.
#
# The UHD backend discovery (ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND AUTO/ON/OFF, UWB_HAVE_UHD,
# UHD::UHD) moved to the top-level CMakeLists.txt so both build modes share
# it.  UWB_HAVE_UHD is a PUBLIC compile definition of uwb_native so consumers
# including uwb_uhd_burst_backend.h / uwb_uhd_sc16_pipeline.h see the guard.
########################################################################

include_directories(../include)

########################################################################
# Pure core sources (no GNU Radio, no UHD)
########################################################################
set(uwb_core_sources
    uwb_demod_pipeline.cc
    uwb_discrete_cir_estimator.cc
    uwb_discrete_cir_reconstruct.cc
    uwb_fixed_tone_cancel_core.cc
    uwb_fullpacket_sic_core.cc
    uwb_preamble_sic_core.cc
    uwb_sic_unified.cc
)

# The runtime capability check MUST be compiled on the baseline ISA: it is the
# entry point that has to run (and refuse) before any AVX-512 kernel can be
# reached.  A separate OBJECT library keeps it out of uwb_simd_apply().
# uwb_kernel_backend.cc lives here too: the per-group selector must be able to
# answer before any wide instruction is reachable, and its override is what QA
# uses to pin a backend.
add_library(uwb_simd_probe OBJECT uwb_simd_runtime.cc uwb_kernel_backend.cc)
target_include_directories(uwb_simd_probe PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include
    ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/include)
target_compile_options(uwb_simd_probe PRIVATE -O3)
set_target_properties(uwb_simd_probe PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# The AVX-512 kernels live in their own translation unit and are built only
# when CMake selected the AVX-512 backend.  The rest of the build stays on the
# AVX2/FMA baseline; the wide functions carry target attributes.
if(UWB_SIMD_HAVE_AVX512)
    list(APPEND uwb_core_sources uwb_rational_resampler_avx512.cc
                                uwb_demod_sic_avx512.cc)
endif()

########################################################################
# Native runtime sources (pipeline, sources, tone decorator; UHD-gated
# device backend)
########################################################################
set(uwb_native_sources
    uwb_uhd_sc16_pipeline.cc
    uwb_fixed_tone_cancel_source.cc
)
if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
    list(APPEND uwb_native_sources uwb_uhd_burst_backend.cc)
endif()

########################################################################
# GNU Radio adapter sources (only compiled when UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO=ON)
########################################################################
set(uwb_adapter_sources
    uwb_energy_detector.cc
    uwb_preamble_detector.cc
    uwb_detector.cc
    uwb_detector_sc16.cc
    uwb_packet_writer.cc
    uwb_scheduled_extractor.cc
    uwb_scheduled_extractor_sc16.cc
    uwb_auto_scheduled_extractor_sc16.cc
    uwb_realtime_demodulator.cc
    uwb_rational_resampler_ccf_65_48.cc
    uwb_rational_resampler_ccf_65_32.cc
    uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_ccf_65_48.cc
    uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_ccf_65_32.cc
    uwb_pdu_window_crop.cc
    uwb_radar_packet_source.cc
    uwb_hrp_packet_source.cc
    uwb_loopback_echo.cc
    uwb_radar_cir_estimator_block.cc
    uwb_cir_writer.cc
    uwb_realtime_echo_timer.cc
    uwb_echo_timer_stream.cc
    uwb_preamble_sic.cc
)

# The python bindings check this variable (GR mode only).
set(uwb_sources "${uwb_adapter_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

########################################################################
# uwb_core: pure C++ core archive
########################################################################
add_library(uwb_core STATIC ${uwb_core_sources}
    $<TARGET_OBJECTS:uwb_simd_probe>)
target_link_libraries(uwb_core PUBLIC Volk::volk Threads::Threads)
target_compile_features(uwb_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(uwb_core
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)
set_target_properties(uwb_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# Central ISA flags (PUBLIC so an installed consumer compiles the header-only
# cores with the same backend).  See cmake/Modules/UwbSimd.cmake.
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_core)

########################################################################
# uwb_native: native RX runtime archive (pipeline + sources + decorator)
########################################################################
add_library(uwb_native STATIC ${uwb_native_sources})
target_link_libraries(uwb_native PUBLIC uwb_core Threads::Threads)
target_include_directories(uwb_native
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)
set_target_properties(uwb_native PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_native)
if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
    target_link_libraries(uwb_native PUBLIC UHD::UHD)
    # Public so consumers including uwb_uhd_burst_backend.h see the guard.
    target_compile_definitions(uwb_native PUBLIC UWB_HAVE_UHD=1)
endif()

########################################################################
# gnuradio-uwb: the GNU Radio adapter shared library (GR mode only)
########################################################################
if(UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO)
    add_library(gnuradio-uwb SHARED ${uwb_adapter_sources})
    target_link_libraries(gnuradio-uwb
        PUBLIC uwb_native
        PUBLIC gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
        PUBLIC gnuradio::gnuradio-filter
        PUBLIC Volk::volk
        PUBLIC Threads::Threads
    )
    target_include_directories(gnuradio-uwb
        PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
        PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
      )
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-uwb PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_uwb_EXPORTS")

    if(APPLE)
        set_target_properties(gnuradio-uwb PROPERTIES
            INSTALL_NAME_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
        )
    endif(APPLE)

    ####################################################################
    # Install built library files
    ####################################################################
    include(GrMiscUtils)
    GR_LIBRARY_FOO(gnuradio-uwb)

    # Version/SONAME regression (2026-11-15 cleanup fix A): VERSION_MAJOR/
    # API/ABI/PATCH must be defined BEFORE include(GrVersion) so GrVersion
    # derives VERSION=1.0.0.0 / LIBVER=1.0.0.  Pin the observable contract:
    # the built shared library carries SONAME libgnuradio-uwb.so.<LIBVER> and
    # the versioned file libgnuradio-uwb.so.<VERSION> exists next to it.
    add_test(NAME uwb_qa_gnuradio_uwb_version
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_uwb_gnuradio_uwb_version.sh
                $<TARGET_FILE:gnuradio-uwb> ${LIBVER} ${VERSION})
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_gnuradio_uwb_version PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
else()
    message(STATUS "UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO=OFF: skipping the gnuradio-uwb adapter "
                   "library; building uwb_core + uwb_native only")
endif()

########################################################################
# M1-B: the standalone, GNU-Radio-free / UHD-free TWR protocol core.
#
# `uwb_twr_core.h` + `uwb_twr_protocol_time.h` are the PUBLIC installed M1-B
# contract.  The core is its OWN archive so an isolated install consumer can
# link it and PROVE (ldd/readelf) that it pulls in neither GNU Radio nor UHD
# (M1-B §8).  The fake link is transport/QA support and is NOT installed.
########################################################################
add_library(uwb_twr_core STATIC uwb_twr_core.cc)
target_include_directories(uwb_twr_core PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(uwb_twr_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

add_library(uwb_twr_fake_link STATIC uwb_twr_fake_link.cc)
target_include_directories(uwb_twr_fake_link PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>)
target_link_libraries(uwb_twr_fake_link PUBLIC uwb_twr_core)

########################################################################
# M2-A: the offline native-rate PHY closed loop (G0 §2).
#
# `uwb_twr_phy.h` is the PUBLIC M2-A entry.  It reuses the header-only
# hrp_mod / rational_resampler / demod cores under ../include, so this archive
# links VOLK + Threads and needs NO GNU Radio runtime.  The install consumer
# proves that with ldd/readelf (G0 §14.1); if libgnuradio-* ever appears here,
# the fallback is header-only + a consumer-only compile check.
########################################################################
add_library(uwb_twr_phy STATIC uwb_twr_phy.cc uwb_twr_phy_impairment.cc)
target_include_directories(uwb_twr_phy PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
target_link_libraries(uwb_twr_phy PUBLIC Volk::volk Threads::Threads uwb_core)
set_target_properties(uwb_twr_phy PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# uwb_twr_phy.h includes uwb_rational_resampler_core.h, so it must compile the
# header-only core with the same ISA as the rest of the build.
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_twr_phy)

########################################################################
# Install the static core/native/TWR archives and their export set.
# GR mode: same export set as gnuradio-uwb (namespace gnuradio::), so the
# exported adapter target file is self-consistent.
# Native mode: a standalone uwb-export (namespace uwb::) installed to
# <libdir>/cmake/uwb together with uwbConfig.cmake, which finds NO
# GNU Radio.
########################################################################
if(UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO)
    install(TARGETS uwb_core uwb_native uwb_twr_core uwb_twr_phy
        EXPORT gnuradio-uwb-export
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${GR_LIBRARY_DIR}
    )
else()
    install(TARGETS uwb_core uwb_native uwb_twr_core uwb_twr_phy
        EXPORT uwb-export
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION ${GR_LIBRARY_DIR}
    )
    install(EXPORT uwb-export
        FILE uwbTargets.cmake
        NAMESPACE uwb::
        DESTINATION ${CMAKE_MODULES_DIR}/uwb
    )
endif()

# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

# GR mode: every QA is registered with GR_ADD_CPP_TEST exactly as before
# (GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS pulls gnuradio-uwb, which now contains the adapter
# classes plus the statically linked uwb_native/uwb_core objects).
# Native mode (UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO=OFF): the core QA is registered with plain
# add_executable/add_test against uwb_native/uwb_core/uwb_twr_phy + Boost;
# the GR-block QA is not compiled at all (its message says so).
########################################################################
if(UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO)

endif()

# Anything we need to link to for the unit tests go here (GR mode)

# Register one QA.  Target/test names are IDENTICAL in both modes
# ("uwb_<file>.cc"), so the per-target compile definitions below apply
# unchanged.
function(uwb_register_qa qa_file)
    if(UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO)
        GR_ADD_CPP_TEST("uwb_${qa_file}"
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file}
        )
    else()
        add_executable("uwb_${qa_file}" ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file})
        target_link_libraries("uwb_${qa_file}"
            PRIVATE uwb_native uwb_core uwb_twr_phy Boost::unit_test_framework)
        if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
            target_link_libraries("uwb_${qa_file}" PRIVATE UHD::UHD)
        endif()
        set_target_properties("uwb_${qa_file}" PROPERTIES
            COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "BOOST_TEST_DYN_LINK;BOOST_TEST_MAIN")
        add_test(NAME "uwb_${qa_file}" COMMAND "uwb_${qa_file}")
    endif()
endfunction()

foreach(qa_file ${uwb_core_qa_sources})
    uwb_register_qa(${qa_file})
endforeach()

if(UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO)
    foreach(qa_file ${uwb_adapter_qa_sources})
        uwb_register_qa(${qa_file})
    endforeach()
else()
    message(STATUS "UWB_BUILD_GNURADIO=OFF: skipped GNU Radio adapter QA files: "
                   "${uwb_adapter_qa_sources}")
endif()

########################################################################
# M1-B pure protocol-core tests.
#
# These link ONLY uwb_twr_core / uwb_twr_fake_link / Boost.Test -- never
# gnuradio-uwb and never UHD -- so a green run is itself evidence that the
# protocol core is radio-free (M1-B §8).  They are registered separately from
# GR_ADD_CPP_TEST because that macro pulls in the whole GR link closure.
########################################################################
function(uwb_add_pure_twr_test test_name test_source)
    add_executable(${test_name} ${test_source})
    target_include_directories(${test_name}
        PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
    target_link_libraries(${test_name}
        PRIVATE uwb_twr_core uwb_twr_fake_link Boost::unit_test_framework)
    set_target_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "BOOST_TEST_DYN_LINK;BOOST_TEST_MAIN")
    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${test_name})
endfunction()

uwb_add_pure_twr_test(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_protocol_time.cc qa_uwb_twr_protocol_time.cc)
uwb_add_pure_twr_test(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_fake_link.cc qa_uwb_twr_fake_link.cc)
# M1-B: the endpoint core unit QA and the two-endpoint end-to-end matrix.
# Both hard-code the expectations they hand-derive; neither reads the goldens
# in testdata/twr/m1b at run time, so they need no UWB_TESTDATA_DIR.
uwb_add_pure_twr_test(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_core.cc qa_uwb_twr_core.cc)
uwb_add_pure_twr_test(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_m1b_e2e.cc qa_uwb_twr_m1b_e2e.cc)

# ########################################################################
# Deterministic library resolution for EVERY test registered above.
#
# M0 review R8 / M0.1 §2.C.4.  GrTest's generated `<test>_test.sh` does
#     export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="":$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# i.e. it APPENDS the caller's LD_LIBRARY_PATH, so the test's RUNPATH (which
# correctly points at the build tree) is only consulted when the caller has
# no LD_LIBRARY_PATH at all.  On this machine the default shell exports
# LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib, so a plain `ctest` run linked the STALE
# installed libgnuradio-uwb rather than the one just built, while
# `env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH ldd` showed the build tree.  A regression pass can
# therefore silently grade a CSV produced by the wrong library.
#
# The fix belongs in the registration, not in the operator's shell: pin
# LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the build tree for every test in this directory, so
# `ctest` and a hand-run of the same script resolve identically.
#
#   - the build lib dir goes FIRST, ahead of anything inherited;
#   - the inherited path is preserved AFTER it, so a developer who really
#     needs an extra path still gets it -- just not in a position that
#     shadows the library under test;
#   - nothing is removed, so this cannot break a working setup.
#
# Not a performance threshold change and not a behaviour change for the
# library: it only decides WHICH copy of the library a test loads.
# ########################################################################
set(UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
if(EXISTS "${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}")
    get_property(_uwb_tests DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
    foreach(_t ${_uwb_tests})
        set_property(TEST ${_t} APPEND PROPERTY
            ENVIRONMENT "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}")
    endforeach()
    message(STATUS "UWB CTest: pinning LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH} for "
                   "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} tests")
endif()

# ########################################################################
# Serial execution for the throughput-sensitive tests.
#
# These measure PDU/s and input MS/s.  Running them concurrently with the rest
# of the suite on a 17-core box makes the numbers depend on how many other
# tests happen to be resident, so a failure cannot be attributed.  RUN_SERIAL
# makes each of them run alone.
#
# NOTE ON uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler.cc: its throughput assertions
# (>400 PDU/s, 200 Hz headroom >2, input >50 MS/s) have a standing historical
# failure tracked separately.  It is listed here for SERIAL EXECUTION ONLY --
# no threshold is changed, relaxed or re-baselined, and a new functional
# failure is never folded into it.
# ########################################################################
set(UWB_SERIAL_TESTS
    uwb_qa_uwb_rational_resampler.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_rational_resampler_65_32_stream.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_65_32.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_65_32_workers.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_sc16_scale_65_32.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_sc16_scale_65_48.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_roi_cir_65_32.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_twr_phy_matrix.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_twr_timing_budget.cc
)
foreach(_t ${UWB_SERIAL_TESTS})
    if(TEST ${_t})
        set_tests_properties(${_t} PROPERTIES RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    endif()
endforeach()

# UHD-gated runtime QA: only compiled when UHD is available; verifies the
# device-unavailable contract without any USRP (skips when one exists).
if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
    uwb_register_qa(qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc)
    # Device discovery can take several seconds on transport timeouts.
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 300)
    # Registered after the LD_LIBRARY_PATH block above, so pin it too.
    if(EXISTS "${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}")
        set_property(TEST uwb_qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc APPEND PROPERTY
            ENVIRONMENT "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}")
    endif()
endif()

# S0-B: the preamble-SIC math core QA.  It cross-checks the optional golden
# vectors under testdata/sic_preamble/golden/ and SKIPS that case cleanly when
# they are absent (they are generated by a separate agent).
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_preamble_sic_core.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\"")
# S0-C: the PDU adapter QA.  Synthetic by default; the OPTIONAL golden case
# reads testdata/sic_preamble/golden/int_single/io.npz when present and skips
# cleanly when it is not, so it needs the testdata root too.
if(TARGET uwb_qa_uwb_preamble_sic.cc)
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_preamble_sic.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\"")
endif()
# TWR M0: three of the five TWR QAs read goldens from testdata/twr/.
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_config_parity.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\"")
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_frame.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\"")
# M1-A reads the physics-derived ToF oracle, so it needs the testdata root.
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_math.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\"")
# The two QAs that EMIT generated tables also need to know which build tree
# they were compiled into.  They write their CSV output under
# ${UWB_BUILD_DIR}/test-output by default and record the ABSOLUTE path of the
# libgnuradio-uwb the running process actually loaded, so a CSV generated
# against a stale /usr/local install is visible instead of silent
# (M0 review R7 / R8, M0.1 §2.C.2).
if(TARGET uwb_qa_uwb_twr_phy_matrix.cc)
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_phy_matrix.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\""
    "UWB_BUILD_DIR=\"${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}\"")
endif()
if(TARGET uwb_qa_uwb_twr_timing_budget.cc)
target_compile_definitions(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_timing_budget.cc PRIVATE
    "UWB_TESTDATA_DIR=\"${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../testdata\""
    "UWB_BUILD_DIR=\"${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}\"")
endif()
# qa_uwb_twr_timestamp and qa_uwb_twr_config are self-contained (no golden
# files) and deliberately get NO UWB_TESTDATA_DIR, so a testdata path
# regression cannot silently degrade into a pass.

########################################################################
# UHD backend dry-run CLI (Radar Step 11)
#
# Pure-contract printer: includes NO UHD header and links neither UHD nor
# gnuradio-uwb, so it cannot open a device by construction.  Registered
# in CTest in both build configurations (UHD ON and OFF).
########################################################################
add_executable(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run uwb_uhd_dry_run.cc)
target_compile_definitions(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run PRIVATE UWB_NO_UHD_LINK=1)
target_link_libraries(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run PRIVATE uwb_core)

add_test(NAME uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run
    COMMAND uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run
        --device-args addr=192.168.10.2
        --rate 737280000
        --tx-channel 0 --rx-channel 1
        --clock-source internal --time-source internal
        --pri-num 3686400 --pri-den 1
        --pre-guard-ticks 1475
        --tx-samples 140982 --rx-samples 55591
        --max-fragment-size 65536
        --t0-ticks 36864000
        --schedule-index 0)

add_test(NAME uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run_rejects_invalid_config
    COMMAND uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run --pri-num 0)
set_tests_properties(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run_rejects_invalid_config
    PROPERTIES WILL_FAIL TRUE)

# Compile the wrapper QA with the SAME SIMD configuration as the fast app.
# (Previously -march=native, which could sneak AVX-512 into an AVX2 build.)
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_fullpacket_fast_rx.cc)
# The fused kernel QA must exercise the same AVX2/FMA path as the fast runner,
# not only the portable multi-accumulator fallback.
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_rx_fused_cmf.cc)
# The fused PHR kernel QA uses the same AVX2/FMA path.
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_rx_fused_phr.cc)
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_uhd_sc16_pipeline.cc)
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_rational_resampler_core.cc)
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_resampler_burst_opt.cc)
uwb_simd_apply(uwb_qa_uwb_rational_resampler_core_65_32.cc)
# uwb_uhd_sc16_pipeline.cc / uwb_rational_resampler_*_ccf_65_48.cc are compiled
# inside uwb_native / gnuradio-uwb, which already inherit the central flags
# (uwb_simd_apply on those libraries).  The old per-source -march=native block
# is removed so there is exactly one place that decides the ISA.
